summary: Bingo (75-ball, 4 difficulties) verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing — /catalog returns 4 difficulties with the expected meta (easy 4x4 1card any_line 5pts no auto-call; moderate 5x5 free-centre any_line 10pts; hard 5x5 free-centre two_lines_corners 20pts auto-call 4s; nightmare 2x 5x5 full_house 35pts auto-call 3s). /daily returns moderate sample card with free centre and 15 pts. /community-events returns the 3 seeded events (evt-weekly-friday, evt-weekend-warmup, evt-nightmare-challenge) each with id/title/subtitle/difficulty/starts_iso/ends_iso/seed/points_on_complete. Session start returns the correct card shape per difficulty (cards count and 4/5 cols, free centre at (2,2) for 5x5). PUT accepts call_index and marked updates and persists (verified by GET). POST /complete returns 400 when there is no valid pattern; on a valid win it awards 5/10/20/35 points respectively, and Hard/Nightmare completions go through log_game_completion without granting the legacy 'expert' key (no 'expert' regression). Community-event start uses the seeded sequence (deterministic across two starts) and the completer appears on /leaderboard with the event's own points_on_complete (25 for Friday Night Bingo). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Games Hub Bingo tile is ready=true (no SOON badge), subtitle reads '75-ball · 4 levels · live events', and the tile is tappable. /games/bingo renders HOW TO PLAY + SpeakButton, Daily Bingo CTA (15 pts), Community Bingo Events list (3 events with seeded labels and points), 4 difficulty rows with correct points (5/10/20/35), and the Start button. /games/bingo/player?sid=... renders the LAST CALL banner, correct card grid per difficulty (Easy=16 cells, Moderate/Daily=25 cells, Hard=25 cells, Nightmare=50 cells across CARD 1 + CARD 2), Call-next visible for Easy & Moderate ONLY (hidden for Hard & Nightmare auto-call), Call BINGO! always visible. Tapping an uncalled number shows 'Not called yet' toast (no toggle). Tapping Call BINGO without a winning pattern shows 'No winning pattern yet — keep going!' toast. TTS calls into expo-speech without error and the call sequence advances and auto-saves (PUT /session/{uid}/{sid} 200s after each call). No red screen or runtime errors. Only pre-existing react-native-web style deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) remain.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' (Pre-existing across the app — not Bingo-specific)
Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' (Pre-existing)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. (Pre-existing)
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Web-only, harmless.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Migrate deprecated RNWeb style props shadow* -> boxShadow, textShadow* -> textShadow, and move pointerEvents from props to style.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1495 bingo_complete correctly routes through log_game_completion (server.py:742-747) which grants 'hard' / 'nightmare' achievement keys matching ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS — the legacy 'expert' key bug previously fixed for Trivia does not reappear for Bingo (verified by automated tests test_hard_completion_grants_hard_achievement_not_expert and test_nightmare_completion_no_expert_regression).
_bingo_check_win covers any_line, two_lines_corners, and full_house (across ALL cards for Nightmare). Free centre is pre-marked at session creation so it is always counted.
Community event sequences are seeded via random.Random(event.seed) so two starts of the same event return identical call sequences — verified by automated test.
Bingo daily uses _bingo_seed_from_date so the daily sample card is deterministic for the calendar day; points_on_complete=15 matches the spec.
server.py is ~2.2k lines — consider splitting routes into per-domain modules (games, auth, social) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None new. Tests use demo users (maggie, frankie, joycey, art) via /api/auth/demo-login and create bingo_sessions documents under their ids; these do not affect production-visible data. Completing the Friday Night event under maggie places her on its leaderboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://george-mcgs-cms.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Bingo regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_bingo.py (run with pytest -v). Demo login: POST /api/auth/demo-login {username}. Key bingo testIDs: bingo-daily, bingo-event-{event_id}, bingo-diff-{easy|moderate|hard|nightmare}, bingo-start, bingo-call-next (Easy/Moderate only), bingo-call-bingo, bingo-cell-{cardIdx}-{col}-{row}. The 'Not called yet' toast and 'No winning pattern yet — keep going!' toast are surfaced via ToastProvider's show(). Achievement granting goes via log_game_completion (server.py:742-747) — guarded against the legacy 'expert' key. expo-speech is invoked when prefs.readMessagesAloud is enabled; we cannot validate audio in the web preview but no JS errors are raised.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs found. The previously fixed 'expert' achievement-key bug (server.py:742-747) is verified for Bingo by two automated tests that assert 'expert' is NOT present in the granted list after Hard/Nightmare completions.
